query.description: Natural language search query (e.g. 'SaaS companies in the US with Series A funding'). Cannot be used with filters.

filters.description: Structured filter conditions. Use the Filter Builder API to generate valid filters. Cannot be used with query. See filter options at /api-reference/listgen-api.

sections.description: Data enrichment sections to include. Values: firmographic, business_model, company_assessment, trust_signal, company_hierarchy, digital_presence, financial_estimate, location, management_profile, product_offering, strategic_signal, customer_profile, industry, technology, funding_detail (Subscription, Enterprise), mna_and_investment (Subscription, Enterprise)

sort_by.description: Field to sort results by. Default: relevance

limit.description: Maximum companies to return. Default: 50, Max: 500

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination. Default: 0
